description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kosgoda, Kuruwita D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620275
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Kosgoda. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, owner information, extent measurements, and legal status of the titles. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it focuses on land registration, ownership determinations, and property title matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
